info.description:
Timeline REST API. Implements technical specification v0.8:
accounts and invites, events and stages, participant assignments,
registration with self-reported status, reminder rules and the audit log.

The system does not verify the external registration site: the status is self-reported
by the user or set administratively.

Authentication is cookie-based: the access token lives 15 minutes, the refresh token
rotates and lives 30 days. Every mutating request must send
a CSRF token in the X-CSRF-Token header; obtain one from GET /auth/csrf.
All timestamps are transferred in UTC using RFC 3339.
info.title: Timeline API

get.description: Restricted to administrators. Entries are immutable; file export is not supported in the MVP.
Administrative list with every state, search and filters.

post.description: The event is created unpublished; end_at must be later than start_at.

patch.description:
Changing end_at increments the registration schedule_version, cancels stale
pending notifications and triggers reconciliation. Violating the condition
deadline_at <= end_at is rejected.

409.description: the registration deadline falls outside end_at

post.description: Terminal state in the MVP: pending notifications are cancelled and no new ones are created.

parameters.description: Include participants removed from the roster
parameters.name: include_removed

post.description:
Re-adding a previously removed participant reactivates the record and increments
assignment_version. The assignment, registration status, primary notification and audit
entry run in a single transaction per participant; the result is returned per entry.

parameters.description: List of users and their roles
parameters.name: request

post.description: Moves participation to REMOVED and cancels pending notifications. Sent ones are preserved.

Only assigned participants are copied. The participant role is copied as a value
by default and can be overridden. Existing participants are skipped
and returned as separate result entries.
post.summary: Copy the roster from another event

post.description:
The event becomes visible to participants and the scheduler; deferred primary
notifications are created by reconciliation.

409.description: the event is already published or archived

post.description:
Creating an active registration creates missing TODO statuses for every assigned
participant. Primary notifications are created only for a published, non-archived
event; otherwise they are deferred until publication. The deadline must satisfy
the condition deadline_at <= event.end_at.

409.description: registration already exists or the deadline falls outside end_at

patch.description:
Changing the link increments notification_content_version; changing the deadline increments
schedule_version. In both cases pending notifications are cancelled and current ones
are created by reconciliation with a new logical key.

post.description: Only TODO and NOT_REQUIRED are accepted. The result is returned per participant.
Returns the number of records to be changed and skipped without modifying data.
Pending notifications are cancelled; statuses are preserved but stop being actionable.

Increments activation_version and schedule_version and creates missing statuses;
participants in TODO receive the primary notification again.

The sign of offset_minutes selects the type: a positive value is a reminder before the deadline,
zero fires at the deadline, and a negative value is an overdue notification.
A registration accepts at most 10 rules.

409.description: a rule with this offset already exists or the slot limit is reached

post.description: Overlapping stages and stages outside the event period are allowed. A stage produces no notifications.

Creation is serialised by normalised email: a previous unaccepted invite is revoked,
then a new one is created. An invite for an existing user address is rejected with a conflict
regardless of that user's activity.

409.description: a user with this email already exists

post.description:
Returns participation to ASSIGNED, increments assignment_version, clears removed_at
and sets the role again. An existing registration status is preserved.

patch.description: team_role is a free-text role on the event, not an access permission.

get.description: Participants in TODO whose deadline has passed while the event has not finished.
Participants in TODO whose deadline falls within the given window.

delete.description:
The rule is set to enabled=false; the row is preserved so that the occupied slot
and offset stay reserved.

patch.description:
Changing schedule fields increments schedule_version once per transaction
and triggers notification reconciliation.

Allowed transitions: TODO to DONE, DONE to TODO, TODO/DONE to NOT_REQUIRED,
NOT_REQUIRED to TODO. Entering TODO increments todo_cycle and clears registered_at.

get.description: All events with filters by state, participant and date range.

Search by display_name and normalised email to pick participants.
Only minimal fields are returned; credentials and channel data are withheld.

delete.description:
Removes credentials and delivery channels, anonymises the name and email.
Participation references and audit entries are preserved.

post.description: Restores access. Previously cancelled notifications are not revived.
Revokes sessions, removes the Telegram link and moves pending notifications to CANCELLED.

get.description: Issues the token in a cookie and in the response body. Every mutating request must send it in the X-CSRF-Token header.

post.description: Promotes pending_email to the primary address. Until confirmation, sign-in uses the previous address.

Issues a 15-minute access token and a rotating 30-day refresh token in HttpOnly cookies.
Rate limit: 10 attempts per 15 minutes per IP and email pair.
post.summary: Sign in with email and password

401.description: invalid credentials or a deactivated account

post.description: Revokes the refresh token of the current session and clears the cookies.
post.summary: Sign out of the current session

post.description: Revokes every active session of the user.
Issues a one-time token valid for 30 minutes. The response does not disclose whether an account exists.
After a password change every active session of the user is revoked.
Rotates the refresh token. Reusing a revoked token revokes the entire session chain.

Creates an account, sends a confirmation email valid for 24 hours and opens a session.
Sign-in is allowed before the address is confirmed; product email notifications are not.
If invite_token is supplied, the invite is accepted in the same transaction.
Consumes a one-time confirmation token valid for 24 hours.

400.description: the token is invalid or has expired

post.description: Rate limit: 5 requests per hour per IP and email pair. The response does not disclose whether an account exists.

get.description:
Every published, non-archived event regardless of participation. The response
carries a dedicated payload that cannot include administrative notes.

The catalog requires a session: an anonymous request is answered with 401. An
unauthenticated listing would enumerate every event of the organisation together
with its organisers and prize pools, and the system is internal. It also carries
its own rate limit, counted per account, because a catalog page is heavier than
other reads: substring search, filters and the stages of the page.

parameters.description: Comma-separated origin filter. Omit it for the All view: RU and WORLD cover every event.
parameters.name: origin

parameters.description: Comma-separated format filter. OFFLINE and HYBRID also match an event whose own format is ONLINE when at least one of its stages is held in person.
parameters.name: format

get.description:
Participant role, computed state, stages, the nearest stage, registration status,
deadline and link. Administrative notes are withheld from the participant.

post.description:
Self-signup: the user joins a published event and supplies their own team role.
A meetup has no team role, so the field may be omitted; for a hackathon it is
required. A finished event cannot be joined: only an administrator may assign a
participant after the fact.

400.description: a hackathon requires a team role

409.description: already a participant, or the event has finished

post.description:
Participant self-report: moves their own TODO status to DONE. Available with an active
registration, an assigned participation and a non-archived event. The system does not verify the external site.

get.description: Available to an assigned participant for a published event, and to an administrator always.

post.description:
Creates an account for the invited address and opens a session.
Any other unexpired invites for this address are revoked in the same transaction.

get.description: Returns the address and expiry of the invite without disclosing any other data.

patch.description: The administrator flag, Telegram chat_id and password are not changed by this endpoint.

post.description:
Revokes sessions, removes the Telegram link and cancels pending notifications.
Reactivation is performed by an administrator.
The new address is stored as pending_email and becomes primary only after confirmation.

get.description:
Published events with an assigned participation: UPCOMING, ACTIVE and FINISHED.
Archived records are hidden by default and available through a filter.

Only assigned, published, non-archived events. Each event is a separate row,
stages are returned as intervals and the registration deadline as a separate marker.

post.description:
Returns a one-time deep link bound to the current user.
The chat identifier is set only by this flow.

get.description:
Protected endpoint. Requires an Authorization header with the METRICS_TOKEN bearer token,
when the token is set by configuration.

Last run times of the scheduler and worker, queue lengths by status
and the age of the oldest pending entry.
Checks that the database is reachable.
